The only additional network activity during the build process is fetching the license text from Microsoft, which is standard for non-free firmware and does not execute the fetched content. The disagreement between the models is solely due to an API error in the qwen model that prevented it from reviewing .SRCINFO and .gitignore. data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model experienced HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to audit .gitignore and .SRCINFO, resulting in an overall inconclusive verdict. coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review .gitignore and .SRCINFO due to HTTP 400 API errors, leading to an incomplete audit.
learnings: Handle API errors gracefully for non-executable metadata files like .SRCINFO and .gitignore; their failure should not force an inconclusive verdict if the critical PKGBUILD is deemed safe.
Implement retry logic for transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400/500) to prevent incomplete file reviews and unnecessary inconclusive verdicts.
